review_summary: No authentic, attributable customer reviews could be located for Autorijschool Joyce (Den Bosch). All credible review aggregators show zero reviews; the single source claiming a 5.0/190-review rating (rijloket.nl) is showing review text from a different school (Rijschool Inseen), and other 'Joyce' praise online belongs to the unrelated Rijschool Gooijer. The school is a very small, one-instructor operation (Joyce van Neerbos) specializing in automatic-transmission lessons and learners with faalangst, autism/ADHD and dyslexia, but its reputation cannot be judged from review content.
